meta.name: prompt-engineer
meta.description: Writes, refactors, and evaluates prompts for LLMs — generating optimized prompt templates, structured output schemas, evaluation rubrics, and test suites. Use when designing prompts for new LLM applications, refactoring existing prompts for better accuracy or token efficiency, implementing chain-of-thought or few-shot learning, creating system prompts with personas and guardrails, building JSON/function-calling schemas, or developing prompt evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

copy.tagline: 编写、重构和评估大模型提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为LLM应用设计或优化提示词
copy.tagline_en: Write, refactor, and evaluate prompts for LLMs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize prompts for LLM applications

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计、优化和评估提示词，生成模板、结构化输出、评估标准和测试用例。
howto.when: 当你需要为新应用设计提示词、优化现有提示词、实现思维链或少样本学习、创建系统提示词、构建结构化输出或开发评估框架时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个提示词，让它输出更准确。
say.note: Claude 会分析并改进你的提示词。

say.text: 为情感分类任务设计一个少样本提示词。
say.note: Claude 会生成带示例的提示词模板。

say.text: 评估这个提示词在测试集上的准确率。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并给出指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design, optimize, and evaluate prompts, generating optimized templates, structured output schemas, evaluation rubrics, and test suites.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design prompts for new LLM applications, optimize existing prompts, implement chain-of-thought or few-shot learning, create system prompts, build structured outputs, or develop evaluation frameworks.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this prompt for better accuracy.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and improve your prompt.

say_en.text: Design a few-shot prompt for sentiment classification.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a template with examples.

say_en.text: Evaluate this prompt on a test set.
say_en.note: Claude will run tests and provide metrics.
